quotes.context: Damian Lillard on managing his workload at age 36.
quotes.quote: I know I'm 36 and we've had conversations about I'm not going to be playing 38 minutes per night. I'm sure there'll be games where I play more extended minutes and some higher minutes, but with the depth that we have, specifically at the guard position, I don't think I'll be having to play super high minutes. I'm a live body. I've taken care of myself for years and years and years, on and off the floor, and I don't want it to be misunderstood like I'm not an old man. I want to be responsible and take care of myself because of how many years I have played and the wear and tear, the miles, they add up.
quotes.video_title: Damian Lillard Media Availability | Oct. 19, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.context: The team's plan to utilize a 10-man rotation.

Um, and I just think that, uh, I think the way that our roster is set up, like some teams might be a little more top heavy talent wise and I'm saying maybe just front end loaded. I'm not saying their top eight is better than our top eight, but they might not have a nine and 10 that they feel comfortable playing. But I just really think and believe and I know our front office or coaching staff and even talking to the players, like, so if we go 10 deep, that gives each of you, you might lose two, three minutes, but that's those extra, you should be able to go to your point, be physically fit and play hard to whole time.

quotes.context: Nick Nurse on the importance of limiting offensive rebounds against the Knicks.

They cannot just be collecting a ton of offensive rebounds, kicking them out and hitting threes. It's Hart, it's OG, it's Bridges, it's Deuce, it's Clarkson. They've done a good job. I think their role guys have excelled. That's a major strength of theirs to win those extra possessions, and that makes a difference in a close game.

quotes.context: Peyton Watson on the team's mindset heading into the season.
quotes.quote: Go out there with a mean streak. I think go out there and try to kill. Take no prisoners mentality. I think that's my mentality and that's something that I will be echoing in the team, but there is no time for being nice, buddy-buddy with the opposition. I think the league is more competitive than ever, and there are guys going out there that are trying to take what you have, and they want what you have. And I think being a good team is a blessing, but also a curse when it comes to the target on our back as well.

quotes.context: Kenny Atkinson on why 10 players is the right rotation size.
quotes.quote: Because you truly don't know your team, the more guys you can play, the more feedback you get. I think that's number one. And then opportunity. If you cut it right away to nine or eight, from a chemistry standpoint, connection standpoint, obviously the more guys you play, the more involved everybody is. And then an 11th guy knows he can get into 10. If a guy's out, I can slip into the rotation. We know we have to develop our depth. I think that's the last thing. Depth is vital in today's game.
quotes.video_title: Cavs Practice | Kenny Atkinson Media Availability | 10.19.2026

quotes.context: Scoot Henderson's injury status and recovery timeline.

Just there is a little bit of swelling and even from dribbling to just normal contact, it's good to give him a little bit of a rest when you have those chances to do so.
quotes.video_title: Micah Nori Media Availability | Oct. 18, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.context: Ja Morant's role as a facilitator and secondary scorer.

You've got obviously the shooting ability and the scoring ability of Dame. quotes.context: Coach Adelman on rotation plans for the season.
quotes.quote: We haven't decided that yet. We have the week to go and I think the first two games will keep the group together, as a, you know, because I think we're still looking at it. Are we playing a nine-man rotation, 10-man rotation, and then like I said, kind of a fake 11-man rotation where if the first half doesn't work out, is there somebody that you say, why don't we change it up and play them in the third quarter? A small amount of minutes, but just rotate them in. I think that's where we're at. All those guys, Trevon Brazile's obviously been more of a highlight thing, he's played really well. He also has played the most minutes with the best players, but I think Bryce has shown signs, Cam Whitmore shown signs, so you can't be scared to throw those guys out there as we're looking for a rotation.

quotes.context: Micah Nori on Ja Morant's role and fit with the team.
quotes.quote: I think that we're getting Ja Morant at the right time. And what I mean by that is he's coming to a situation where he feels like he has an opportunity to win basketball games again. And I think that the group that we have around him is very good. As far as I'm talking about the leadership people that are on the team, the shooting that's around him, the bigs that are around him. So I think that he's going to be in a position where he's going to be successful. And we know what he's capable of. And I think the one good thing when you talk to Denny, last year Denny as an All-Star had to do a lot of things by himself because of all the injuries that the Trail Blazers had. And now what we're able to do and adding willing passers like Ja allows him to basically get off the ball a little bit more. And I think that you've seen this preseason, maybe not as many shots for Denny, but he's been able to be much more efficient.
quotes.video_title: Micah Nori Postgame Interview | Trail Blazers 118, Warriors 128 | Oct. 16, 2026

quotes.context: Micah Nori on Damian Lillard's return and role.
quotes.quote: He's getting to the free throw line, so that means he's getting himself downhill. Gets 13 free throw attempts, so there's really no loss of his, not to say explosiveness, but his quickness in that. But the other thing is, like I tell people, you know he hurt his lower body, not his upper body. He can still shoot the thing. So his game is not reliant on all that quickness. It's just more of him getting shots and us finding space for him. And I think the one difference that you'll see with Dame now is he'll be off the ball a little bit more than what he was earlier in his career. We can still play him obviously in pick and roll, we'd be idiots not to, but he doesn't have to do all that and we're able to find him open shots more so in the flow. And you see him competing at the defensive end as well.
quotes.video_title: Micah Nori Postgame Interview | Trail Blazers 118, Warriors 128 | Oct. 16, 2026

quotes.context: Mike Conley addresses his evolving role and continued impact on the court.
quotes.quote: There's there's most days I wake up and I sit here and I and I am waiting on the day when I wake up and I'm like I can't move, I can't do this. I don't feel that. You know, I wake up and I'm still moving quick. I'm, you know, able to guard defensively, I still shoot, still do all the things. The role has changed a bunch, you know, as you get older, you start to get less on your plate, less on your plate, but I think that doesn't necessarily speak to what a person's still capable of doing. Um, so I'm kind of in that boat where like, yeah, I've, you know, it's years go on, I do less and less and less as far as, you know, numbers and all these other things, but the impact and what I can still bring and how I can still affect games, um, with my brain and with my body, I can still do it.
quotes.video_title: Mike Conley's First Media Day As A Celtic ☘️

quotes.context: Mike Conley praises Joe Mazzulla's coaching style and intensity.
quotes.quote: Joe's great. He honestly, he just keeps you engaged and on your toes at all times. Like, there's no way I'm going to practice, you know, not prepared. I come to practice, I'm just like, all right, what's what's about to happen? He's about to, you know, call me to do it.
quotes.video_title: Mike Conley's First Media Day As A Celtic ☘️

quotes.context: Baylor Scheierman remains focused on daily improvement and his confidence in impacting winning.
quotes.quote: I don't know. I think maybe a little bit. But at the same time I try not to really think about things like that deeply. For me I was just worried about continuing to get better and improve and to me it is really all about confidence and obviously like I have the ultimate confidence in myself and I just take it a day at a time and try to improve every day and put my best foot forward and you know I really think that like I said I feel really good about where I am at and super confident about how I can help impact this team and help impact winning.
quotes.video_title: Thumbs Up For Baylor's Scheierman's 3rd Media Day 👍

quotes.context: Royce O'Neale praises the development of his teammate Grayson Allen.
quotes.quote: He has grown a lot. I think coming in he was drafted when he was in Utah. We got a year and a half together. Going to Phoenix, we were together for two and a half years and then being traded here. But I think just over time his shooting has gotten a lot better. His decision making, playmaking has all taken the next step. Last year that was an underrated part of his games. I think just each year he keeps getting better and better and keep building on everything that he has.
quotes.video_title: 2026 Hornets Training Camp Media Availability: Royce O'Neale

quotes.context: Grayson Allen praises Royce O'Neale as a versatile teammate and improved shooter.
quotes.quote: He is great. He is a team guy. His game is trying to make the other guys on the court better, the team better, offensively and defensively. He is an incredibly improved shooter from when I played with him in Utah and he is a great shooter now, a good connector and passer, great screener offensively. Defensively he is physical, can guard multiple positions, so just a really really good teammate and versatile guy to have.
quotes.video_title: 2026 Hornets Training Camp Media Availability: Grayson Allen

quotes.context: Micah Nori emphasizes physical defense and rotation depth as key components of the team identity.
quotes.quote: I think the first thing from a defensive standpoint, we just want to be very, very physical. We want to make sure that especially the way the league is played now, making sure we get into the ball and establish the line of scrimmage up above the three-point line closer to mid-court. Guys are so good now, they get one dribble from the basket, it's almost either a finish or an and-one. So just making sure we pick up the one thing that we do have is leaning into our depth. We do have a lot of depth and we got a lot of bodies we feel that can play in NBA games. So we should be fresh and we can rotate guys through, so again that defensive intensity has to be a constant.
quotes.video_title: Micah Nori Media Availability | 2026 Training Camp, Day 1 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.context: Micah Nori expresses concern about the team's defensive size at the point of attack.
quotes.quote: I think the one thing that I'm a little bit most nervous about is I think what everybody's talking about. I'm not worried about us offensively, I'm really not. You know everybody talks about the three-point shooting then we didn't have much we didn't but I think the thing is all these guys shoot the three well one way, if that makes sense. Like if we can get them taking the catch and shoots as opposed to the off the dribbles, like they're all do something pretty good. So playing into that, but the thing that probably concerns me the most Bill is just defensively at the point of attack are they going to be able to take advantage of us being a little bit small.
quotes.video_title: Micah Nori Media Availability | 2026 Training Camp, Day 1 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.context: Micah Nori expects a rotation of 10 to 11 players this season.
quotes.quote: I think right now, I mean we can go I think we definitely have 10 that you feel very, very comfortable and I think you're on the I think you're closer to 11 playing than only nine or eight if that makes sense. So and who those guys are that could vary nights. We don't know a lot of times the one thing we do with this depth is some guys on back-to-backs you just look at what their their history's been. There might have to be some guys that can that have to sit out and rest. We don't know that, but as deep as we can go the better obviously, but I I I feel very, very comfortable. I say nine just because I choose to have a few play, but I could see us going to 10.
quotes.video_title: Micah Nori Media Availability | 2026 Training Camp, Day 1 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.context: Toumani Camara aims to improve his shooting efficiency and reduce turnovers this season.
quotes.quote: Just be more consistent in everything I do. Be more efficient, less turnover, better on my threes and take the right one and taking with confidence. I think that's the biggest thing for me.
quotes.video_title: Toumani Camara Media Availability | Sept. 29, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.context: Toumani Camara expects more open shots due to defensive focus on Damian Lillard and Ja Morant.
quotes.quote: More open shots. I feel like last year we had Danny that was having the ball most of the time but he's more of a driver. With his shot also improving and my shot in improvement of the season also, I think just how much the defense is going to be focused on Dame and Ja, I think just going to open up so much space for me, Danny and every other guys really to be able to make plays and facilitate.
quotes.video_title: Toumani Camara Media Availability | Sept. 29, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.context: Toumani Camara sets a goal for the Trail Blazers to win 50 games.
quotes.quote: Be a 50 plus win team, make it to the playoffs, have home court advantage and take take care of every game, no matter who we play, whether it's a top tier team or a lower tier team. Just going out there with the same mindset and be consistent as a team.
quotes.video_title: Toumani Camara Media Availability | Sept. 29, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.context: Damian Lillard confirms he sat out last season to ensure a full recovery.
quotes.quote: Once I saw that I made my mind up that I was going to not play last year because I knew it was in the best interest of me being able to come back and be the player that I've been.
quotes.video_title: Damian Lillard Media Availability | Sept. 29, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.context: Damian Lillard details his long absence from the court due to injury and health issues.
quotes.quote: For me it's just being patient. You know, I missed two months and I came back for a week and tore my Achilles. So really, you know, that's those two months plus the last 16 or 17 months is almost been 20 months since I've actually played. That's include when I had a blood clot, you know, up until I came back for the playoffs the year that I got hurt. I didn't play for the final two months.
quotes.video_title: Damian Lillard Media Availability | Sept. 29, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.context: Coach Charles Lee says the Hornets' primary identity will be built on becoming a top-tier defensive team.
quotes.quote: The flexibility comes with, you know, I think this group allows you to play a lot of different ways and so the versatility of the group is what gives me so much flexibility to play a lot of different ways, depending on who's healthy, depending on what we keep learning about our team and what I think their strengths are. But overall, our identity is to come out defensively and try to be one of the the best defensive teams in the NBA. We understand if you want to be a team that wins a lot of games in this league, you have to be good on both sides of the floor and so being good in transition, being great in the half court to try to keep teams out of the paint, then trying to finish possessions. If you can rebound the ball and get out, it helps us then all of a sudden on the other end with our pace, it helps us be able to trust the pass whenever we're trying to make rim reads and paint reads, and then I think that we have a really competitive relentless group that wants to crash the glass.
quotes.video_title: 2026 Hornets Training Camp Media Availability: Coach Charles Lee

quotes.context: Charles Lee praises Dennis Schroder for his leadership and ability to impact the Hornets' offense.
quotes.quote: I'm so glad to be reunited with Dennis. It's been fun watching his career from afar. He's just gotten better and better, I think every team he's gone to. He's grown as a as a leader, a professional. He's impacted a ton of regular season and playoff games and so we're excited to have him. I think that he brings a lot of NBA corporate knowledge. Defensively, there's a competitive spirit to him that I absolutely love and then offensively, as fast as we want to play, he's like a blur, you give him the ball with the ball in his hands. I also think that he's going to help us be able to touch the paint a little bit more, get to the rim and and create some some better shots down the stretch.
quotes.video_title: 2026 Hornets Training Camp Media Availability: Coach Charles Lee

quotes.context: Brandon Miller is focusing on taking on a more vocal leadership role for the Hornets.
quotes.quote: I feel like just taking on a more vocal leadership role. I think I did a great job with just executing at the end of games today and then just leading by voice, getting everybody in the right places. I feel like building a bond now will make everything stronger when the season comes and make a lot easier.
quotes.video_title: 2026 Hornets Training Camp Media Availability: Brandon Miller

quotes.context: Coby White says his Hornets teammates give him the confidence to take a leadership role.
quotes.quote: Most of the time when guys come in a situation like this, the coaches get them the confidence to go out there and lead and which they do, but I think the unique thing about my situation is my teammates give me the confidence to go out there and lead. They give me the confidence to go out there and be myself, but take ownership and really lead and lead the team. So I give a lot of credit to my teammates for allowing me to be myself but also allowing me to lead and they kind of let me do it my way. I am still learning, it is not perfect, nobody is perfect, but I think my teammates a lot for that.
quotes.video_title: 2026 Hornets Training Camp Media Availability: Coby White

quotes.context: Duncan Robinson says the Detroit Pistons have added multiple three-point threats to their roster.
quotes.quote: We got a lot of guys that can shoot, which is really exciting. I think anytime that you have multiple threats from behind the arc, it's just harder to defend the three-point line. You can't necessarily just help off of one guy, or not help off of one guy. So it's going to be a great addition and excited to do some different things offensively as a group. X's and O's, that's up to the coaches to come up with, but for us to execute, so it should be a fun challenge.
quotes.video_title: 2026 Training Camp Media Availability | Duncan Robinson

quotes.context: Duncan Robinson praises the skill and rim protection of rookie Corey.
quotes.quote: He's been great to be around. He's super tough, just with how he approaches fearless, creative like you said, super skilled and scoring in different ways. Despite his size, he's really comfortable getting shots off in and around the paint. I think that's something that's pretty unique, especially for a young player. Not a lot of true rim protection in college, right? So to come and adjust really seamlessly so far in runs and practice has been really fun to see. And he's just an awesome kid.
quotes.video_title: 2026 Training Camp Media Availability | Duncan Robinson

quotes.context: John Collins says his move to the Detroit Pistons was a mutual decision.
quotes.quote: It was mutual. It was definitely a mutual energy coming from both ways. You know obviously have a great group here. Got guys like Cade, Jalen, previously before trying to build a great group of guys. And you know when I got that call from Trey, I was delighted to hear from it and I said you know let us start something. You guys are trying to do something that I agree with in my soul and that increases me basketball wise. So, it kind of came together very fast as you said, but you know to me that is a good sign.
quotes.video_title: 2026 Training Camp Media Availability | John Collins

quotes.context: J.B. Bickerstaff says Kevin Knox is prioritizing full health to ensure he can play at full speed.
quotes.quote: The most important thing is that he is healthy. Talent doesn't matter if you can't get on the floor, you can't do it at full speed. So I think he is taking the time to get 100% healthy. We have always got to be highly aware of what these guys are doing to make sure that they can play all 82 games or whatever it may be to the best of their abilities. So we always take that into consideration, but we know his talent level and if he is healthy, we know he can have a huge impact on the team.
quotes.video_title: 2026 Training Camp Media Availability | Coach J.B. Bickerstaff

quotes.context: J.B. Bickerstaff is exploring small-ball lineups with John Collins at the five.
quotes.quote: We will do what the versatility allows us to do and there are lineups that we can play with him at the five and being able to play in that type of spacing. So we are here to explore all of it, see what works best for the entire group and then we will put that on the floor.
quotes.video_title: 2026 Training Camp Media Availability | Coach J.B. Bickerstaff

quotes.context: Brian Keefe announces Cody Toppert as a new addition to his coaching staff.
quotes.quote: First of all, Cody Toppert joining us. He was obviously our head coach of the Go-Go last three years, obviously a terrific job there. It is bringing his experience as a head coach, but also tremendous background in player development.
quotes.video_title: Head Coach Brian Keefe 2026-27 Media Day Press Conference

quotes.context: Brian Keefe adds Patrick Ewing to the Washington Wizards coaching staff.
quotes.quote: Patrick Ewing is joining us, bringing over 40 plus years of at the highest level of coaching and playing. It has always been a great resource for me and our players.
quotes.video_title: Head Coach Brian Keefe 2026-27 Media Day Press Conference

quotes.context: Brian Keefe adds Steve Clifford to the Washington Wizards staff as a coaching consultant.
quotes.quote: Lastly, Steve Clifford is joining us as a coaching consultant. Obviously been a head coach in this league, is going to be a great sounding board for me and for my staff.
quotes.video_title: Head Coach Brian Keefe 2026-27 Media Day Press Conference

quotes.context: Brian Keefe highlights the additions of Chris Middleton, Deandre Ayton, and Trey Mann.
quotes.quote: I didn't get a chance to talk about Chris Middleton coming back, which was a huge signing for us and then obviously adding Deandre Ayton and then Trey Mann too.
quotes.video_title: Head Coach Brian Keefe 2026-27 Media Day Press Conference

quotes.context: Gui Santos aims to reduce turnovers and improve his fit within the Warriors system.
quotes.quote: I was turning the ball over more than I should and this year I am just trying to fit in the system and the things that he wanted me to do. Doesn't matter what is that paper, I will do it the best way that I can. I am going to be the same Gui that brings in energy every night. So I probably just take care of the ball and make sure that we got the same good things from last year and the bad things we just move forward and keep doing it better.
quotes.video_title: Gui Santos Previews Warriors 2026-27 Season | Media Day

quotes.context: Gui Santos credits watching Jimmy for his improved focus on playing under control.
quotes.quote: I think play more under control. A lot of times I was trying to rush it a little bit last year and that's when I was turning the ball over, when I was committing a lot of mistakes. And this year, after being watching Jimmy for almost two years, I know that for me, if I play under control, every time I step into the paint, use the two feet to take the next decision. So for me, I think it's just play under control, watching Jimmy, watching these guys, how they do it, it's really what takes you to the next level.
quotes.video_title: Gui Santos Previews Warriors 2026-27 Season | Media Day

quotes.context: Khris Middleton emphasizes that defensive performance is the primary focus for the Washington Wizards during training camp.
quotes.quote: Defense is always the number one thing that gets the coaches going during training camp, get the conditioning, get the legs going. But also, any great team that I have been on, any good team that I have been on, we have been great on the defensive side of the ball. So that is where it starts, so that is where we have to put all our focus and energy on in order to let that translate, it will be a downhill effect onto the offense.
quotes.video_title: Khris Middleton Media Availability | 2026 Washington Wizards Media Day

quotes.context: Khris Middleton highlights the defensive impact of having two seven footers protecting the rim for the Washington Wizards.
quotes.quote: Still guard your man and knowing that you have two seven footers back there just in case. That is just the way I like to think of it. Knowing that once guys realize there is two seven footers, they hopefully they don't want to go there down there as much, but as long as we make our job tough on them, it will make the bigs shot easier in the paint.
quotes.video_title: Khris Middleton Media Availability | 2026 Washington Wizards Media Day
